item.title: Poland’s Eycore secures first Earth images from flagship satellite
item.description: WARSAW, Poland — Polish space company Eycore has presented the first images of the Earth’s surface captured by its flagship EYCORE-1 satellite, demonstrating the performance of the company’s synthetic aperture radar (SAR) system.
